title: Unique Crispy German Pork Stir Fry
description: A charred and crisp German dish featuring pork, vegetables, and a hint of sweetness from caster sugar, this stir-fry is an adventurous twist on traditional German cuisine, and is friendly to those with nut allergies.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper to the skillet and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned pork back to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together the caster sugar, salt, black pepper, and apple cider vinegar.
Pour the sugar and vinegar mixture over the pork and vegetables in the skillet.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
